convert_udop_checkpoint: convert a UDOP checkpoint from the original Microsoft repository to Hugging Face transformers format
run_convert_udop_cli: run the convert_udop_to_hf.py CLI script to convert a UDOP model checkpoint
test_udop_forward_pass: test the UDOP model single forward pass with dummy inputs
test_udop_generation: test the UDOP model autoregressive text generation with document inputs
push_udop_to_hub: push a converted UDOP model and processor to the Hugging Face hub
